title: Fresh text specificity of layer 2 qkv
question: Does layer 2 q k v alone carry the full dial tilt change on fresh text while layer 3 q k v does not
prediction: On set B the full dial gave relative change -0.268 [F112] with layer 2 q k v share 0.7971 [F113] and other 29 share 0.2191 [F114]. We predict the same pattern on fresh text with layer 2 share near 0.8 and layer 3 share near zero.
intervention: Use the frozen C5 adapter with subsets switched on. Measure tilt at 32768 tokens with 7 periods and shams. Compare baseline to full dial to layer subsets.
conditions: Baseline with adapter off which is dial at 0. Tilt measured at 32768 tokens.
Full dial with all 32 modules on at dial scale 2. Tilt measured at 32768 tokens.
Layer 2 q k v only with 3 modules on at dial scale 2. Tilt measured at 32768 tokens.
Layer 3 q k v only with 3 modules on at dial scale 2. Tilt measured at 32768 tokens.
control: Layer 3 q k v at dial scale 2 with same module count and rank. It is the same kind and size in a different layer. It should not flatten tilt if layer 2 specificity is right.
books: 5 books from set C. Use only text beyond token 70000. This segment has not been used. It tests generalization.
primary_metric: Share of full tilt change. It equals baseline tilt minus subset tilt divided by baseline tilt minus full tilt. It is computed from mean tilt across 5 books.
pass_rule: PASS if layer 2 share is at least 0.6 and absolute layer 3 share is at most 0.3. Threshold 0.6 is set because it requires a majority of effect which rules out diffuse causes. Threshold 0.3 is set because it caps control effects which rules out layer general causes. Rule is fixed before any data.
failure_meaning: If layer 2 share is low then localization fails to generalize. If layer 3 share is high then effect is not layer 2 specific. Either failure means the localized dial claim needs revision.
risks: Fresh text may shift baseline tilt which could add noise.
Small full effect would make share ratio noisy which could give inconclusive outcome.
why_this_next: C7 showed localization but layer 3 alone was never isolated. Fresh text beyond 70000 has not been used. This test checks generalization and specificity in one run. It decides if the dial is a true localized mechanism.
